rules.name: Random bytes requested
rules.description: The sample asks the kernel for random bytes: a key, a nonce or an identifier. Not suspicious by itself — meaningful next to file writes.

rules.name: XOR or bit-shift heavy loop
rules.description: The classifier sees a loop that mixes several bit operations: the shape of a hand-rolled cipher, a string obfuscator or a simple unpacker. The rule reports the shape, not the intent, and inherits the classifier's confidence.

rules.name: Recursive file walk with writes
rules.description: The sample both opens files for writing and requests random bytes: the classic combination of a ransomware encryptor, worth reading line by line.

rules.name: Encrypted-looking extensions
rules.description: Strings that look like the extensions or note names a locker leaves behind.
